scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Assistance for Interest Subsidy to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprise (Manufacturing Sector)
other_conditions: Must be a Micro, Small or Medium enterprise with acknowledgment or registration from the Ministry of MSME or the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).
New enterprises or existing enterprises undertaking expansion or diversification are eligible.
Must commence commercial production or rendering services during the scheme's operative period.

Must submit an online application within one year of the first loan disbursement, commencement of commercial production/services, or GR issue date, whichever is later, and before the scheme's last operative date.
Must pay regular installments and interest to the bank/financial institution.
benefits_summary: Interest subsidy on term loans ranging from 5% to 7% with maximum amounts up to ₹35 lakh per annum for periods of 5‑7 years.
